title: UniMatSim: A High-Throughput Materials Simulation Automation Framework Based on Universal Machine Learning Potentials
title_zh: UniMatSim：基于通用机器学习潜力的高通量材料模拟自动化框架
summary: 通用机器学习原子间势 (UMLIP) 的精度接近第一性原理计算，而成本却很低，显示出大规模材料模拟的巨大潜力。然而，碎片化的UMLIP生态系统缺乏统一的接口标准和集成框架，阻碍了它们在高吞吐量工作流程中的自动化部署。为了解决这个问题，我们提出了 UniMatSim，一个模块化的 Python 框架。它系统地集成了各种 UMLIP（例如 CHGNet、M3GNet、MACE），并自动化了从结构优化到稳定性验证的工作流程。
abstract: arXiv:2603.15294v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Universal machine learning interatomic potentials (UMLIPs) offer accuracy close to first-principles calculations at a fraction of the cost, showing significant potential for large-scale material simulations. However, the fragmented UMLIPs ecosystem lacks unified interface standards and integration frameworks, hindering their automated deployment in high-throughput workflows. To address this, we present UniMatSim, a modular Python framework. It systematically integrates various UMLIPs (e.g., CHGNet, M3GNet, MACE) and automates workflows from structural optimization to stability verification. The framework enables seamless model switching via abstracted interfaces, incorporates task orchestration, and provides standardized modules for key properties (elasticity, phonons, molecular dynamics), including automated handling for low-dimensional materials. As a test case, using the 2D Lieb lattice system, we constructed a multi-stage high-throughput screening workflow covering structural optimization, elastic stability, and phonon spectrum calculations. Starting from 1,176 candidate compositions, a four-model consensus pipeline yields 393 stable structures. These are refined by magnetic-state screening and DFT band-structure calculations to 59 Lieb-lattice candidates with staggered-magnetic-band characteristics. Results show UniMatSim significantly improves computational efficiency and reproducibility, providing a reliable infrastructure for data-driven materials discovery and design.

title: Machine learning interatomic potentials and orientational defects in polymers
title_zh: 机器学习聚合物中的原子间势和取向缺陷
summary: 丙烯酸酯环氧化大豆油 (AESO) 的光聚合是一种柔软的生物基材料中自组织过程的便捷模型：紫外线引发自由基链式反应，不断增长的网络释放热量，分子团的迁移率同时在多个时间尺度上发生变化。我们从两个方面跟踪这个过程。
abstract: arXiv:2611.24148v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Photopolymerization of acrylated epoxidized soybean oil (AESO) is a convenient model of a self-organizing process in a soft, bio-based material: ultraviolet light starts a free-radical chain reaction, the growing network releases heat, and the mobility of molecular groups changes on several time scales at once. We follow this process from two sides. Experimentally, the real and imaginary parts of the dielectric permittivity of an AESO:VDM (1:0.5) mixture with 3 mol% of the photoinitiator DMPA were recorded at 500-5000 Hz under an intermittent on/off illumination protocol, and the resulting time series were analysed with a sliding-window Shannon entropy and the Grassberger-Procaccia correlation integral. Both measures show that short light pulses at the start of curing trigger strongly correlated, collective relaxation, which fades as the network forms, leaving only localized reorientations active. We describe these reorientations as orientational defects and quantify their energetics with the MACE-OFF23 machine learning interatomic potential, using relaxed dihedral scans of five rotational modes (α, α/β, β, γ, δ) of an AESO fragment. Compared with density functional theory (DFT) reference profiles, MACE reproduces the shape of all five profiles (Pearson r=0.95-0.98) and the hierarchy of barriers - from 2.9 eV for the constrained main-chain rotation, through 0.54-0.81 eV for the acrylate rotations, to 0.16-0.18 eV for the methyl and 0.06 eV for the hydroxyl rotation - while underestimating the barrier heights by 3-20%. A simple Arrhenius estimate shows that the acrylate rotations are the modes closest to the frequency window of the dielectric measurement.

title: A GPU-Native Nested Sampling Framework for Finite-Temperature Materials Modelling with Machine-Learned Interatomic Potentials
title_zh: 用于具有机器学习原子间势的有限温度材料建模的 GPU 原生嵌套采样框架
summary: 现代等变机器学习原子间势（MLIP）极大地提高了原子模拟的准确性和可达到的尺度，但将这些势转化为有限温度相稳定性预测所需的热力学采样方法在计算方面却未能跟上。我们提出了 GPU 原生的大规模并行嵌套采样框架 JAXRENS，它在 JAX 之上实现，消除了阻止原子嵌套采样与最先进的 MLIP 相结合的实际瓶颈。该框架提供分布式多 GPU 执行、步行者矢量化集合以及与现代力场的直接互操作性。
abstract: arXiv:2611.24088v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Modern equivariant machine-learned interatomic potentials (MLIPs) have dramatically improved the accuracy of and the scales accessible to atomistic simulation, yet the thermodynamic sampling methods needed to turn those potentials into finite-temperature phase stability predictions have not kept pace computationally. We present the GPU-native, massively parallel nested sampling framework JAXRENS, implemented on top of JAX, which removes the practical bottlenecks preventing atomistic nested sampling from being combined with state-of-the-art MLIPs. The framework provides distributed multi-GPU execution, vectorised ensembles of walkers, and direct interoperability with modern force fields. We demonstrate the highly beneficial scaling of JAXRENS on hardware accelerators, and apply it to the simulation of the ZnS phase diagram based on a MACE foundation model, a procedure previously computationally inaccessible. Despite requiring in the order of 10¹⁰ model evaluations, the final converged simulation completed within six days on four GPUs, marking an important step towards routine, first-principles-quality predictions of finite-temperature phase stability using machine-learned interatomic potentials.

title: Uncovering the Structural, Electronic, and Electrostatic Landscapes of SrTiO₃ Grain Boundaries via Grand Canonical Monte Carlo with a Machine-Learning Interatomic Potential
title_zh: 通过具有机器学习原子间势的大正则蒙特卡罗揭示 SrTiO₃ 晶界的结构、电子和静电景观
summary: 钙钛矿的晶界表现出丰富的电子、极性和磁性特性，但识别其原子结构和成分仍然具有挑战性。在这里，我们将大正则蒙特卡罗（GCMC）方法与通用机器学习原子间势相结合，探索 Σ5(310)[001] SrTiO₃ 晶界的耦合成分和结构相空间。由此产生的化学势相图确定了属于四个基序家族的十个稳定结构：大型 Sr 风筝、小型 Sr 风筝、不完整的 Sr 大风筝和富钛结构。
abstract: arXiv:2611.24097v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Grain boundaries in perovskites exhibit a rich variety of electronic, polar and magnetic properties, yet identifying their atomic structures and compositions remains challenging. Here, we combine the Grand Canonical Monte Carlo (GCMC) method with a universal machine-learning interatomic potential to explore the coupled compositional and structural phase space of Σ5(310)[001] SrTiO₃ grain boundaries. The resulting chemical potential phase diagram identifies ten stable structures belonging to four motif families: large Sr kite, small Sr kite, incomplete Sr large kite, and Ti-rich structures. Extending the GCMC method to the Sigma5(210)[001] and Sigma17(410)[001] grain boundaries reveals how grain boundary plane and inclination angle influence the competition between small- and large-kite motifs. Density functional theory calculations of the predicted Sigma5(310)[001] grain boundaries show that the composition and atomic structure strongly govern the spatial distribution of conduction and valence band edge states, interfacial band alignment, and carrier localization. Four distinct electronic regimes emerge: localized electron-doped, delocalized electron-doped, insulating, and hole-attracting states. Our electrostatics analysis reveals the coexistence of the short-range electric fields at the reconstructed GB core associated with local atomic density and bonding, and the longer-range fields outside the core arising from the space charge. These fields can also couple to local polar distortions and generate composition-dependent polarization patterns. These results establish an efficient framework for exploring oxide perovskite grain boundary structures and reveal how stoichiometry and atomic reconstruction couple to electronic structure, electrostatics, and local polarization, providing a route toward predictive grain boundary engineering in functional perovskites.

title: Defect-limited thermal transport in AlN using pretrained machine-learning interatomic potentials
title_zh: 使用预训练的机器学习原子间势在 AlN 中进行缺陷限制热传输
summary: 氮化铝（AlN）是一种重要的热管理材料，其高晶格热导率受到氧杂质的强烈抑制。我们使用预先训练的通用机器学习原子间势 (MLIP)、分子动力学 (MD) 和声子玻尔兹曼输运计算来研究与氧相关的缺陷引起的声子散射。几个预训练的 MLIP 以声子色散和原始热导率的密度泛函理论为基准。为了平衡精度和计算速度，我们使用紧凑 SevenNet-Nano 模型的微调版本进行 MD 模拟。蒙特卡罗退火支持结合 VAₗ(O_N)₃ 配合物的形成，其散射与其孤立成分的散射不同。
abstract: arXiv:2610.08013v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Aluminum nitride (AlN) is an important thermal management material whose high lattice thermal conductivity is strongly suppressed by oxygen impurities. We investigate phonon scattering by oxygen-related defects using pretrained universal machine-learning interatomic potentials (MLIPs), molecular dynamics (MD), and phonon Boltzmann transport calculations. Several pretrained MLIPs are benchmarked against density functional theory for phonon dispersions and pristine thermal conductivity. To balance accuracy and computational speed, we use a fine-tuned version of the compact SevenNet-Nano model for MD simulations. Monte Carlo annealing supports the formation of bound VAₗ(O_N)₃ complexes, whose scattering differs from that of their isolated constituents. Defect scattering rates extracted from excess spectral energy density (SED) linewidths agree reasonably with harmonic T-matrix predictions at low oxygen contents, supporting the independent-scatterer approximation. Incorporating these rates into an iterative Boltzmann transport equation with Bose--Einstein statistics yields thermal conductivities comparable to experimental values and captures their observed decrease with oxygen content. At high concentrations, however, the scattering rate deviates from linear scaling with oxygen content, suggesting limitations of independent-defect and pristine-phonon descriptions. These results demonstrate an efficient approach using pretrained MLIPs to quantify defect-limited thermal transport and provide insights into impurity effects beyond the dilute-defect approximation.

title: Physics-Guided Crystal Structure Elucidation from Powder X-Ray Diffraction with Universal Machine-Learning Interatomic Potentials
title_zh: 利用通用机器学习原子间势通过粉末 X 射线衍射进行物理引导晶体结构解析
summary: 从粉末 X 射线衍射 (PXRD) 中确定独特的原子坐标仍然具有挑战性，因为峰重叠、轻元素的弱散射、具有相似原子序数的元素之间有限的散射对比度以及实验噪声使得逆问题无法确定。在这里，我们提出了 XCAPE（XRD 约束加速预测引擎），这是一种晶体结构预测 (CSP) 框架，它将实验得出的成分、晶胞参数、空间群和 PXRD 数据集成到对称感知进化搜索中。
abstract: arXiv:2611.23760v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Determining unique atomic coordinates from powder X-ray diffraction (PXRD) remains challenging because peak overlap, weak scattering from light elements, limited scattering contrast between elements with similar atomic numbers, and experimental noise render the inverse problem underdetermined. Here, we present XCAPE (XRD-Constrained Accelerated Prediction Engine), a crystal structure prediction (CSP) framework that integrates experimentally derived composition, unit cell parameters, space group, and PXRD data into a symmetry-aware evolutionary search. XCAPE explores Wyckoff-site configurations using tailored mutation operations, evaluates candidates by both energetic stability and diffraction agreement, and accelerates geometry optimization using a universal machine-learning interatomic potential (MLIP). The framework recovered 71 of 77 database-derived benchmark structures (92.2%) from simulated PXRD patterns and all 12 reference structures from experimental PXRD patterns. It further identified 12 candidate structure assignments that are consistent with experimental PXRD patterns, lack matching entries in the Inorganic Crystal Structure Database (ICSD), and are thermodynamically competitive at the MLIP level. Density functional theory (DFT) calculations showed that 10 of these 12 candidates lie within 10 meV/atom of the convex hull. By bridging experimental diffraction data and physically plausible atomistic models, XCAPE can provide structural insight into previously unresolved materials and support accelerated materials discovery in automated research workflows.

title: Application of Pretrained Universal Machine Learning Force-Fields for Phase Transitions Prediction in ZrO2
title_zh: 预训练通用机器学习力场在 ZrO2 相变预测中的应用
summary: 相对于密度泛函理论，预训练的通用机器学习力场可以降低有限温度分子动力学的成本。然而，大多数基准测试仅测试静态属性，并且不评估这些模型是否再现了正确的相变序列。在这里，我们使用声子色散计算和可变单元等温等压分子动力学对氧化锆 (ZrO2) 的十个开源通用机器学习力场进行基准测试。氧化锆是一种有用的测试，因为它在熔化前具有三个热力学稳定的结晶相，遵循单斜晶系-四方晶系-立方晶系的顺序。
abstract: arXiv:2611.23535v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Pretrained universal machine-learning force fields can reduce the cost of finite-temperature molecular dynamics relative to density functional theory. However, most benchmarks test only static properties and do not assess whether these models reproduce the correct phase-transition sequence. Here, we benchmark ten open-source universal machine-learning force fields for zirconia (ZrO₂) using phonon dispersion calculations and variable-cell isothermal-isobaric molecular dynamics. Zirconia is a useful test because it has three thermodynamically stable crystalline phases prior to melting, following the sequence monoclinic-tetragonal-cubic. Four models reproduce this sequence: 7net-l3i5, MatterSim-v1.0.0-1M, MACE-mpa, and MACE-D3. Models with orthorhombic-tetragonal energy errors above about 10 meV/atom (7net-0, CHGNet, and MACE) instead produce an orthorhombic intermediate and predict monoclinic-orthorhombic-tetragonal-cubic-liquid upon heating. ORB-based models fail to sustain stable variable-cell dynamics because their phonon frequencies are compressed by 30-60% relative to the density functional theory reference. Across all ten models, two ground-state diagnostics predict finite-temperature behavior. Relative polymorph energetics should agree with the matched density functional theory reference within about 6 meV/atom, and the phonon spectrum should not show systematic softening. These diagnostics are practical screening metrics for assessing pretrained force fields for phase-transition predictions.

title: Interpretable machine learning of formation energies and band gaps in hybrid perovskites through SHAP analysis and SISSO modelling
title_zh: 文献研究：Interpretable machine learning of formation energies and band gaps in hybrid perovskites through SHAP analysis and SISSO modelling
summary: Accurate and interpretable property prediction is essential for exploring hybrid organic–inorganic perovskites. Here, we combine machine-learning screening with SHAP analysis and SISSO descriptor disc…
abstract: Accurate and interpretable property prediction is essential for exploring hybrid organic–inorganic perovskites. Here, we combine machine-learning screening with SHAP analysis and SISSO descriptor discovery. Using 4,456 compounds, optimized XGBoost models achieved test-set R² values of 0.99 for formation energy and 0.93 for band gap and were applied to over 180,000 candidates. Comparison across approximately 17,000 common compounds revealed broadly overlapping distributions from XGBoost and CGCNN but substantially lower predictions from UPET, suggesting potential limitations in its transferability to hybrid organic–inorganic perovskites. SHAP analysis and correlation-based pruning retained eight primary features for each property, from which SISSO derived expressions comprising four nonlinear descriptors. These expressions couple molecular and inorganic properties for formation energy and emphasize relative atomic sizes and B-site characteristics for band gap. This framework supports efficient candidate prioritization and interpretable analysis of learned structures–property relationships in hybrid perovskites.

title: Neural SPICE Surrogate Modeling and Sensitivity Analysis for Semiconductor MOSFETs: A Deep Learning Framework for Accelerated VLSI Simulation
title_zh: 文献研究：Neural SPICE Surrogate Modeling and Sensitivity Analysis for Semiconductor MOSFETs: A Deep Learning Framework for Accelerated VLSI Simulation
summary: Modern Very Large Scale Integration (VLSI) electronic design automation (EDA) workflows rely heavily on circuit simulation engines (SPICE) to resolve large systems of non-linear differential-algebraic…
abstract: Modern Very Large Scale Integration (VLSI) electronic design automation (EDA) workflows rely heavily on circuit simulation engines (SPICE) to resolve large systems of non-linear differential-algebraic equations. As semiconductor dimensions scale, computing drain current characteristics iteratively via traditional numerical techniques introduces severe computational latency, particularly across extensive Monte Carlo process-variation sweeps. In this work, we propose a deep learning surrogate modeling framework to approximate device-level non-linear transport physics. The surrogate establishes a direct forward mapping F[𝑉𝑔𝑠, 𝑉ds, 𝑉𝑡ℎ, 𝜇0, 𝜆]--> Id across all operating regimes (cutoff, linear, and saturation) utilizing a high-capacity Multi-Layer Perceptron (MLP) architecture equipped with continuous Sigmoid Linear Unit (SiLU) activations. Trained on synthetically generated physical parameter profiles, the model demonstrates rapid convergence, driving means squared loss from an initial 0.122 down to 0.0078 with a coefficient of determination R² > 0.98 on unobserved test partitions. Furthermore, a normalized sensitivity analysis identifies gate bias 𝑉𝑔𝑠 and threshold voltage 𝑉𝑡ℎ as primary driving variables, fully consistent with metal-oxide-semiconductor field-effect transistor (MOSFET) electrostatics. The proposed surrogate achieves evaluation latencies under 2 milliseconds, providing a scalable path toward accelerated analog, digital, and post-silicon statistical simulations.

title: Orientation-Tunable Interfacial Thermal Conductance in Lateral MoSe2/MoS2 Heterostructures: A Deep Potential Molecular Dynamics Study
title_zh: 横向 MoSe2/MoS2 异质结构中方向可调的界面热导：深势分子动力学研究
summary: 管理横向二维过渡金属二硫属化物 (TMD) 异质结构中界面的热流是下一代纳米电子和光电器件的关键挑战。为了解决这个问题，我们使用 DeePMD-kit 在密度泛函理论 (DFT) 数据上训练了深度学习原子间势 (DLP)，然后将其与非平衡分子动力学 (NEMD) 模拟配对，以研究横向 MoSe2/MoS2 异质结构中的界面热导 (ITC)，同时考虑扶手椅和锯齿形界面方向。我们训练的势与 DFT 能量、力和声子色散关系密切匹配，这证实了其热传输模拟的可靠性。
abstract: arXiv:2611.24547v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Managing heat flow across interfaces in lateral 2D transition-metal dichalcogenide (TMD) heterostructures is a key challenge for next-generation nanoelectronic and optoelectronic devices. To tackle this, we trained a deep learning interatomic potential (DLP) using DeePMD-kit on density functional theory (DFT) data, then paired it with non-equilibrium molecular dynamics (NEMD) simulations to study interfacial thermal conductance (ITC) in lateral MoSe₂/MoS₂ heterostructures, considering both armchair and zigzag interface orientations. The potential we trained closely matches DFT energies, forces, and phonon dispersion relations, which confirms its reliability for thermal transport simulations. Examining cell lengths from 10 to 40 nm and extrapolating to infinite length, the armchair interface shows a higher ITC (473 MW/m²K) than the zigzag interface (387 MW/m²K), and the armchair interface remains higher at every length considered. Both increase further as temperature rises. At 300 K, the vibrational density of states shows greater phonon spectral overlap at the armchair interface than at the zigzag interface. Together, these results offer a solid machine-learning framework for studying heat transport in lateral TMD heterostructures, and identify interface orientation as an effective means of controlling heat dissipation at these junctions.

title: GEODE: Symmetry-Preserving Cartesian Diffusion for Crystal Generation
title_zh: 文献研究：GEODE: Symmetry-Preserving Cartesian Diffusion for Crystal Generation
summary: Most known inorganic crystals exhibit symmetric atomic arrangements, yet generative models often fail to reproduce them. Explicitly enforcing these symmetries has so far yielded fewer stable and novel…
abstract: arXiv:2610.01898v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Most known inorganic crystals exhibit symmetric atomic arrangements, yet generative models often fail to reproduce them. Explicitly enforcing these symmetries has so far yielded fewer stable and novel structures than unconstrained generation. We introduce Generative Equivariant Orbit Diffusion Engine (GEODE), to our knowledge the first model to combine coordinate and lattice diffusion in Cartesian space. GEODE first samples symmetry templates, then jointly generates the lattice, atomic coordinates and atom types while preserving the specified symmetry with a novel Wyckoff-constrained loss. Cartesian diffusion gives coordinate noise a consistent physical scale that we empirically demonstrate improves performance. Unconditional generation achieves a metastable, unique and novel (mSUN) rate of 11.9%, compared with 7.7% for the next best symmetry-aware model. We also introduce sampling time template filtering, which increases mSUN by ~6% without retraining, making GEODE competitive with leading symmetry-agnostic models. Template selection also enables joint symmetry and property guidance, which we demonstrate through classifier-free guidance of permittivity.

title: Gradient-estimator design overcomes trainability barriers in neural-network-based variational optimization
title_zh: 文献研究：Gradient-estimator design overcomes trainability barriers in neural-network-based variational optimization
summary: Neural networks provide expressive representations for scientific computing. However, even sufficiently expressive networks can suffer training failure in weak-gradient regimes, limiting their practic…
abstract: Neural networks provide expressive representations for scientific computing. However, even sufficiently expressive networks can suffer training failure in weak-gradient regimes, limiting their practical use in quantum many-body physics and ab initio quantum chemistry. Here we derive an unbiased direct gradient estimator and introduce the adaptive minimum-variance phase (AMVP) estimator for neural-network variational optimization. By improving the signal-to-noise ratio of weak gradients, these methods enable reliable scientific calculations where training previously failed, while substantially reducing computational cost. The framework enables compact networks to outperform larger and fine-tuned default standard-estimator models with over an order of magnitude less GPU time on correlated flux models, and ultimately exceed the density matrix renormalization group (DMRG) accuracy. It further achieves chemical accuracy in N2 bond breaking and, for the first time, in heavy-element I2 with explicit spin–orbit coupling. These results demonstrate that gradient-estimator design expands the capabilities of neural-network variational methods for accurate scientific computing.

title: Characterizing adsorption thermodynamics in carbon capture materials: an efficient first-principles approach
title_zh: 表征碳捕获材料的吸附热力学：一种有效的第一原理方法
summary: 多孔材料为二氧化碳捕获提供了广阔的设计空间，其探索取决于控制吸附的热力学的高效和准确的第一原理预测。然而，当与分子相互作用的精确从头计算处理相结合时，使用大规范分子模拟来模拟等温线和吸附热在计算上极其昂贵，从而限制了对亨利常数编码的低压吸收的筛选。识别和设计最佳的二氧化碳捕获材料需要一种能够使用从头计算势能表面（例如现在可从基础机器学习原子间势能 (MLIP) 获得的势能表面）有效计算其吸附特性的策略。
abstract: arXiv:2611.24759v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Porous materials offer a vast design space for CO₂ capture, whose exploration hinges on efficient and accurate first-principles predictions of the thermodynamics governing adsorption. However, simulating isotherms and heats of adsorption using grand canonical molecular simulations is extremely computationally expensive when combined with accurate ab initio treatments of the molecular interactions, limiting screening to low-pressure uptake encoded in the Henry constant. Identifying and designing the best CO₂ capture materials requires a strategy that can efficiently calculate their adsorption properties using ab initio potential energy surfaces such as those now available from foundational machine-learned interatomic potentials (MLIPs). Here we develop a neural classical density functional (cDFT) framework for carbon capture processes that allows direct calculation of adsorption isotherms from low to high loading limits of metal-organic frameworks (MOFs) without grand canonical simulations. We demonstrate the success of our approach by calculating the ab initio adsorption isotherms for over 5,000 experimentally reported MOFs. From our screening, we show how these materials can be characterized using four isotherm shapes, arising from their pore size and binding sites, which the Henry constant cannot distinguish. We show that these shapes, rather than the binding strength alone, decide which MOFs suit which process: small pores with strong binding sites for vacuum and temperature swings at low pressure, large pores with weakly binding walls for pressure swings. Finally, we identify the most promising candidates by weighing their working capacity against the energy needed for regeneration.

title: Topological Quantum Reservoir Computing
title_zh: 拓扑量子储层计算
summary: 扩展通用量子计算并使用受保护的逻辑量子位实现量子机器学习仍然具有挑战性。为了利用现有容错量子平台的计算潜力，我们引入了拓扑量子库计算，这是一种利用受保护的存储自由度和主机系统的内在动态进行信息处理的新颖方法。使用一维 Kitaev 链，我们展示了长寿命的马约拉纳边缘模式和快速批量响应如何在同一多体系统中支持这些互补功能。我们确定了管理对受保护内存的访问的权衡，并展示了匹配的接口如何实现可编程写入和交互，从而实现从大量到边缘的自主信息整合。
abstract: arXiv:2611.24013v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Scaling universal quantum computation and implementing quantum machine learning with protected logical qubits remain challenging. To harness the computational potential of existing fault-tolerant quantum platforms, we introduce topological quantum reservoir computing, a novel approach using protected degrees of freedom for storage and the host system's intrinsic dynamics for information processing. Using a one-dimensional Kitaev chain, we show how long-lived Majorana edge modes and fast bulk responses support these complementary functions within the same many-body system. We identify the tradeoffs governing access to protected memory and show how matched interfaces enable programmable writing and interactions enable autonomous information consolidation from the bulk to the edge. These mechanisms improve performance on tasks requiring long-term retention of temporal information. Our results establish topology as a new resource for quantum reservoir computing and open a route toward near-term quantum computing and quantum machine learning.

title: Confidence-Based Materials Data Quality Assessment via Domain Knowledge and Graph-Structured Learning
title_zh: 通过领域知识和图结构学习进行基于置信度的材料数据质量评估
summary: 材料机器学习的快速发展依赖于大规模、异构的数据集，但模型的可靠性常常受到来自不同实验、模拟和数据库集成的不完美数据的影响。现实世界的材料数据库可能包含测量错误、计算失败、记录丢失或重复以及隐藏的物理化学约束违规行为。此类问题很难识别，因为损坏的样本可能在统计上仍然合理，而不是显示为明显的异常值。在本文中，我们提出了一种基于置信度的材料数据质量评估框架，它将领域知识与图结构学习相结合。
abstract: arXiv:2611.23342v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: The rapid development of materials machine learning relies on large-scale, heterogeneous datasets, yet model reliability is often compromised by imperfect data from diverse experiments, simulations, and database integration. Real-world materials databases may contain measurement errors, failed calculations, missing or duplicate records, and hidden violations of physicochemical constraints. Such problems are difficult to identify because corrupted samples may remain statistically plausible rather than appearing as explicit outliers. In this paper, we propose a confidence-based materials data quality assessment framework that integrates domain knowledge with graph-structured learning. Data quality is formulated as a continuous confidence estimation problem rather than a binary anomaly identification task, enabling sample-level assessment and historical-reference-based batch comparison. A nine-dimensional feature-quality prior and duplicate-aware sample initialization are calibrated using materials domain rules and statistical evidence. Confidence is further refined through sample-feature bipartite graph propagation and weakly supervised graph attention, while a Memory-GAT module provides historical reference scoring. Experiments on 23 ODDS benchmark datasets show that the generic module achieves an average AUC-ROC of 0.866. In five repeated mixed-contamination experiments on mp₂₀, rule calibration improves HistGradientBoostingRegressor test R² from 0.538±0.008 to 0.616±0.014. Graph refinement increases average precision from 0.943±0.004 to 0.953±0.004, while the rule-calibrated configuration has the highest mean test R² among the evaluated screening configurations. Five repeated MACE subset experiments further show an increase in R² from 0.590±0.053 to 0.880±0.027 after rule-based screening.

title: Generative molecular design needs oracle grounding
title_zh: 文献研究：Generative molecular design needs oracle grounding
summary: Generative molecular design is guided by oracles, computational proxies of experimental goals that models can exploit. We argue that oracle grounding, in which experiments diagnose and correct oracle…
abstract: Nature Computational Science, Published online: 19 November 2026; doi:10.1038/s43588-026-01082-x Generative molecular design is guided by oracles, computational proxies of experimental goals that models can exploit. We argue that oracle grounding, in which experiments diagnose and correct oracle failures, will allow generative models to discover not only new molecules but also new chemistry.

title: Generative discovery of chemical reaction networks
title_zh: 化学反应网络的生成发现
summary: 了解化学反应性需要揭示一组给定反应物可进入哪些途径、它们如何竞争以及连续反应如何重塑混合物。自动鞍点搜索可以仅从反应物中进行探索，但随着连续步骤中竞争路径的积累，其计算成本急剧上升。生成过渡状态的机器学习方法通常需要预定义的产品，但识别这些产品是探索的中心目标。在这里，我们介绍 ReactNexus，这是一个生成框架，可以直接从反应物图生成过渡态候选，而不指定产物，预测它们连接的物种，并利用反应性机器学习潜力来细化路径来指导网络探索。
abstract: arXiv:2610.38236v2 Announce Type: replace-cross Abstract: Understanding chemical reactivity requires uncovering which pathways are accessible from a given set of reactants, how they compete, and how successive reactions reshape the mixture. Automated saddle-point searches can explore from reactants alone, but their computational cost rises sharply as competing pathways accumulate across successive steps. Machine-learning approaches to transition state generation typically require predefined products, yet identifying those products is a central goal of exploration. Here we introduce ReactNexus, a generative framework that generates transition-state candidates directly from reactant graphs without specifying products, predicts the species they connect, and refines pathways with a reactive machine-learned potential to guide network exploration. Its models were trained on a quantum-chemical database of 130 million structures from 1.1 million reaction records, spanning 11 elements and multiple charge and spin states. On held-out reactions, 93.6% of generated candidates refined to valid transition states at the density functional theory level, and 83.3% connected the supplied reactants to distinct products. Across decomposition, complex rearrangements, and organocatalysis, ReactNexus reveals how competing mechanisms shape product formation, uncovering pathways missed in previous studies. In a multisite nucleophilic aromatic substitution, ReactNexus identified diarylation products that explained initially unassigned LC-MS signals, with structural assignments supported by NMR after isolation. ReactNexus also predicted an additional product family not detected under the initial conditions; subsequent higher-temperature experiments provided LC-MS evidence supporting its formation. This work highlights the potential of generative models to extend mechanistic analysis to increasingly complex reaction mixtures.

title: Hidden topological signatures in a van der Waals ferromagnet revealed by spin-resolved circular-dichroic photoemission
title_zh: 自旋分辨圆二向色光发射揭示了范德华铁磁体中隐藏的拓扑特征
summary: 具有强相关电子的层状铁磁体为探索磁性、自旋轨道耦合和非平凡能带拓扑之间的相互作用提供了一个平台。 Ni₁/4TaSe2 是相关范德华铁磁体，转变温度为 58 K，其成分与 Ni 耗尽时出现的超导相接近。在这里，我们结合自旋和角分辨光电子能谱、圆二色性测量和密度泛函理论计算来研究其自旋分辨电子结构。我们观察到跨越费米能级的自旋极化态以及铁磁态中时间反转对称性破缺的特征。自旋分辨圆二色性测量进一步揭示了与有限自旋贝里曲率一致的螺旋度相关的自旋响应，并暗示了局部拓扑特征。
abstract: arXiv:2611.24468v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Layered ferromagnets with strongly correlated electrons provide a platform for exploring the interplay among magnetism, spin-orbit coupling, and nontrivial band topology. Ni₁/₄TaSe₂ is a correlated van der Waals ferromagnet with a transition temperature of 58 K that lies close in composition to a superconducting phase that emerges upon Ni depletion. Here, we combine spin- and angle-resolved photoemission spectroscopy, circular-dichroism measurements, and density functional theory calculations to investigate its spin-resolved electronic structure. We observe spin-polarized states crossing the Fermi level and signatures of broken time-reversal symmetry in the ferromagnetic state. Spin-resolved circular-dichroism measurements further reveal a helicity-dependent spin response consistent with a finite spin Berry curvature and suggestive of local topological character. Together, these results establish an experimental connection between ferromagnetism, spin-polarized electronic states, and topological signatures in Ni₁/₄TaSe₂, providing a foundation for investigating how these properties may relate to the emergence of superconductivity upon Ni depletion.

title: Hierarchical coupling in tripartite van der Waals cavity magnonics for a low-loss and tunable coupled-mode Hamiltonian
title_zh: 三方范德华腔磁振子学中的分层耦合，用于低损耗和可调谐耦合模式哈密顿量
summary: 腔磁振子学 (CM) 的最大优点之一是能够探索丰富的耦合模式物理，由磁振子共振和磁子-光子耦合的大原位通量可调性驱动。同时，范德华 (vdW) 磁体无需复杂的制造工艺即可实现超紧凑且高度集成的 CM 实施。尽管如此，大量的磁振子损失严重阻碍了所有这些优点的结合。在这里，我们利用 CrCl3 在三方 vdW CM 中实现了分层反交叉结构，并实现了有效的耦合双模哈密顿量。我们在保持强耦合条件的同时实现了损耗的数量级降低。
abstract: arXiv:2611.23756v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: One of the greatest merits of cavity magnonics (CM) is the ability to explore rich coupled-mode physics, driven by the large in situ flux tunability of magnonic resonances and magnon--photon coupling. Meanwhile, van der Waals (vdW) magnets offer an ultra-compact and highly integrated implementation of CM without complex fabrication processes. Nonetheless, the substantial magnon losses significantly hinder the combination of all these advantages. Here, we realize a hierarchical anti-crossing structure in a tripartite vdW CM with CrCl3 and realize an effective coupled-dual-mode Hamiltonian. We achieve an order-of-magnitude reduction in loss while maintaining a strong coupling condition. Additionally, we theoretically confirm the feasibility of simultaneous and in situ tuning of both loss and coupling by varying the magnetic field direction and strength. Featuring a micrometer-scale thickness and a width of a few millimeters, our device is significantly smaller than those based on bulk crystals or crystal arrays. Our results establish vdW cavity magnonics as versatile platform for investigating intriguing phenomena predicted in coupled-mode systems.

title: Two-Dimensional Ferromagnetic Weyl Half-Semimetal
title_zh: 二维铁磁外尔半金属
summary: 二维（2D）铁磁拓扑材料为实现自旋极化拓扑态提供了有吸引力的平台，但外尔费米子和强大的高温铁磁性的共存仍然难以捉摸。在这里，基于第一性原理计算和蒙特卡罗模拟，我们预测单层 BaMn₄O₈ 是一种动态、热和机械稳定的铁磁 Weyl 半金属。 textcolorblue{对 20×20×1 晶格进行各向异性蒙特卡罗模拟，得到大约 1446~K 的有限尺寸跃迁估计。} 自旋分辨电子结构揭示了完全自旋极化状态，其中自旋向上通道在费米能级附近具有线性韦尔带交叉，而自旋向下通道保持绝缘。
abstract: arXiv:2611.23688v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Two-dimensional (2D) ferromagnetic topological materials provide appealing platforms for realizing spin-polarized topological states, yet the coexistence of Weyl fermions and robust high-temperature ferromagnetism remains elusive. Here, based on first-principles calculations and Monte Carlo simulations, we predict monolayer BaMn₄O₈ to be a dynamically, thermally, and mechanically stable ferromagnetic Weyl half-semimetal. textcolorblue{An anisotropic Monte Carlo simulation on a 20×20×1 lattice yields a finite-size transition estimate of approximately 1446~K.} The spin-resolved electronic structure reveals a fully spin-polarized state, in which the spin-up channel hosts linear Weyl band crossings near the Fermi level, whereas the spin-down channel remains insulating. Corresponding Fermi-arc edge states connecting the projected Weyl points (WPs) are clearly observed along the (100) boundary, confirming the nontrivial topology. Importantly, both the Weyl points and their associated Fermi arcs remain robust in the presence of spin--orbit coupling (SOC). textcolorblue{These results identify monolayer BaMn₄O₈ as a candidate for fully spin-polarized topological transport.
